schedule.daily: Every morning 06:10 ET, retries 07:10 and 08:20: process the previous session and freeze forecasts before the open

schedule.aiHealthCheck: Tue-Sat 08:50 ET: a Claude session checks the cycle ran and opens a fix PR if something broke
schedule.aiResearch: Sunday 10:05 ET: a Claude session reviews the lab and live record and proposes new experiments as a PR
schedule.aiReview: 1st of each month 11:36 ET: a Claude session writes a methodology and evidence review
